# Section order

Section order should reflect what the target role needs to evaluate first.

## Experienced professionals

Recommended default:

1. Header and contact information
2. Summary, when it adds positioning value
3. Technical Skills or core competencies
4. Experience
5. Education
6. Relevant optional sections

For many experienced candidates, Experience can appear before Technical Skills when recent accomplishments are the strongest evidence.

## Early-career candidates

Education, internships, projects, and relevant skills may move upward when professional experience is limited.

## Optional sections

Use Projects, Certifications, Publications, Patents, Awards, Speaking, Volunteering, Military Service, Languages, or other sections only when they strengthen fit or explain meaningful experience.

Do not include a section merely because the framework supports it. Relevance outranks completeness.
